title: feat: preselect the last pack bought for returning buyers
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The wallet now preselects a returning buyer’s most recent checkout pack when it matches an available pack. An explicitly chosen pack still takes priority; otherwise, the auto top-up amount remains the fallback, followed by the existing default. GET /api/stripe/billing now returns lastPackAmountUsd from the latest checkout credit, or null before a buyer’s first checkout.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shop, Polli wears a tiny shopkeeper apron and points to a familiar lime green (#ecf874) Pollen pack on a shelf beside a glowing retro checkout screen and potted code-flowers. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, strictly pixel art, never realistic, against soft pastel gradients and warm lighting—cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
